paragraphs: In Gittin 52b Rav Ashi said: “Rav Kahana and I signed the deed of Ze’ira the orphan’s mother, who was selling land for the poll-tax,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Gittin 52b passage explicitly names Rav Ashi and Rav Kahana and describes the mother’s land sale for the poll tax; the abbreviated quotation here does not add its further legal discussion.
